intro: Farming Simulator 25 projects focused on realism, control and quality of life, plus companion utilities for managing and understanding the worlds behind the game.

mods.name: Crop Control Override
mods.summary: Crop availability, NPC field regeneration and regional crop-calendar control.

mods.name: HelperProfiles
mods.summary: Create and manage a custom worker roster with roles and availability.

mods.name: HelperPayroll
mods.summary: Give hired labour a meaningful payroll cost tied to your worker system.

mods.name: AvatarSwitcher
mods.summary: Save, organise and reuse player appearances through an in-game preset system.

mods.name: RemoteDispatcher
mods.summary: Remotely start AutoDrive or CoursePlay for an AI Worker.

mods.name: SaveUnitProfiles
mods.summary: Apply regional currency and measurement profiles independently to each savegame.

mods.name: StopTime
mods.summary: Stop the in-game clock instantly and resume at the previous time scale.

mods.name: PrecisionNutrition
mods.summary: More depth and visibility for livestock nutrition and feeding.

mods.name: ExportLivestockInfo
mods.summary: Export FS25 livestock data to structured CSV or Excel reports for analysis and record keeping.
